text:
### Never Collect Without Consent
❌ Political beliefs
❌ Religious beliefs
❌ Sexual orientation
❌ Health information (unless relevant)
❌ Criminal records (unless legally required)
name: Chunk 29/61

raw_entities.name: Never Collect Without Consent
raw_entities.description: A mandatory compliance obligation prohibiting the collection of sensitive personal data categories without explicit customer consent. The obligation covers political beliefs, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, health information (unless relevant), and criminal records (unless legally required).

raw_entities.name: Prohibition on Collection of Political Beliefs
raw_entities.description: A specific prohibition against collecting data on a customer's political beliefs without explicit consent.

raw_entities.name: Prohibition on Collection of Religious Beliefs
raw_entities.description: A specific prohibition against collecting data on a customer's religious beliefs without explicit consent.

raw_entities.name: Prohibition on Collection of Sexual Orientation
raw_entities.description: A specific prohibition against collecting data on a customer's sexual orientation without explicit consent.

raw_entities.name: Prohibition on Collection of Health Information Without Relevance
raw_entities.description: A specific prohibition against collecting health information unless it is relevant to the banking relationship or service being provided.

raw_entities.name: Prohibition on Collection of Criminal Records Without Legal Requirement
raw_entities.description: A specific prohibition against collecting criminal record data unless legally required by regulatory or statutory obligations.
